heading: INT. ECOLE DU SILENCE - MIME ACADEMY - REHEARSAL HALL - DAY

units.text: INT. ECOLE DU SILENCE - MIME ACADEMY - REHEARSAL HALL - DAY
A mirrored studio with a barre along one wall.
Chalk marks on the floor.
A cardboard sign taped to the door reads: SILENCE, PLEASE.
SERIOUSLY.
FELIX ODENKIRK, 30s, in a striped shirt, white-gloved, painted white-faced, stands in a glass box that does not exist.
His hands slide along invisible walls.
His mouth hangs open in fear.
A line of sweat cuts through the greasepaint.
He pushes at the wall.
He pushes harder.
He leans his whole weight on it, then slumps in defeat and wipes his brow.
PROFESSOR GIOVANNA BIANCHI-NNAMDI, 50s, enters from the wings in a black leotard and a beret, carrying a stopwatch.
She holds up one finger.
Felix freezes.
She taps the stopwatch and circles him with a critical eye.
You are not trapped.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: I thought that's the point.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: You are trapped in a box. But you are not afraid. You are bored.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: I've been in here for forty minutes.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: That is what bored looks like.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: She reaches into her pocket, takes out a banana, and hands it to him.
He examines it, bewildered.
She makes the shape of a phone with her hand, holds it to her ear, and nods meaningfully.
Felix peels the banana and holds it to his ear.
Hello? Yes, this is Felix.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: No. Silently.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: How can I speak silently?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Shhh!
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: She presses a finger to his lips.
He freezes.
She steps back, folds her arms, and stares at him with utter disappointment.
A door opens at the far end of the hall.
A new figure, short and round in a brilliant red cape and a feathered cap, bursts in at a run.
This is a CAPED MAN, 60s, with a waxed mustache and the bearing of a retired emperor.
He stops dead when he sees the banana.
Who has brought fruit into my hall?
units.name: CAPED MAN

units.text: Giovanna and Felix flinch together.
Felix hides the banana behind his back.
Giovanna puts her hands over her mouth.
Speak!
units.name: CAPED MAN

units.text: You told us not to speak.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Maestro Escobar, please, he is only a student.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: Silence, young man!
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Escobar glares.
Giovanna backs toward the barre.
Felix mimes zipping his lips and pulls an invisible key from his pocket.
He tosses it over his shoulder.
Escobar watches it fly.
He flares his nostrils, stomps three steps, plucks the banana from Felix's hand, and sniffs it with narrowed eyes.
Ripe.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Maestro, it was a teaching tool.
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: Banana is not a tool. Banana is an emotion.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: He peels it with theatrical care.
He takes a bite, closes his eyes, and chews with an expression of sublime serenity.
Felix mimes applause with his gloved hands, all pantomime, no sound.
Giovanna copies him.
Escobar opens one eye.
You. Young man. What is your name?
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Felix.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Felix, you have the soul of a cabbage.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It was not a compliment.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: I know.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: But I admire your honesty. You will be in my box tomorrow.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Which box?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: The real box.
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Giovanna stifles a gasp.
Escobar finishes the banana and holds the peel aloft, then lets it fall, and the three of them watch it drift to the floor.
A pause.
In the profound quiet, Felix makes the smallest sound, a cough.
Shhh!
units.name: ESCOBAR

units.text: Shhh!
units.name: GIOVANNA

units.text: Felix presses both hands to his mouth, eyes wide.
The mirrors multiply the three of them, their white gloves and wide eyes receding into infinity.
Nobody makes a sound.
A stopwatch ticks.
